title: Bradenton Beach Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Bradenton Beach Marina specializes in bottom painting, using the finest paints for Florida’s waters. Our 77-ton Marine Travelift boat hoist can handle most boats up to 80 feet in length. Our certified paint applicators are familiar with the latest antifouling paint technologies and can recommend the proper paint for your vessel. Are you buying a boat and need it hauled out for inspection? Do you need your vessel unloaded from a trailer or decommissioned for transport? Bradenton Beach Marina can haul out most boats up to 80 feet. We can step sailboat masts, we can remove or install radar arches, hard tops, and fly bridges, and we can perform any other services you need to get your boat

services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: Experience the enchantment of watching playful dolphins dancing in their natural habitat. Led by experienced guides aboard the Anna Maria Explorer, these daytime or sunset tours offer an unparalleled opportunity to witness these majestic creatures up close, creating cherished memories that will stay with you long after the tour. Dolphin tours here in the bays of Anna Maria Island and Sarasota Bay are unlike any other in the world. Our Atlantic Bottlenose Dolphins are non-migratory, which means they stay here year-round and for life. On our dolphin tours, you will get to learn about these amazing creatures, our special island, the historic Cortez Fishing Village, and all the unique wildlife
